findings.claim: The new early return in CollectGeneric skips every generic type (closed or open) whose OriginalDefinition has no syntax. Types such as List<T>, Dictionary<K,V> and ImmutableArray<T> are normally handled by the built-in or collection-formatter checks earlier in CollectCore. A referenced-assembly generic with a custom formatter is also handled earlier. A generic collection type reaching this point would previously be formatted via the generic branch, so skipping it could drop formatters for non-built-in generic collections or tuples. This changes which types get formatters but not how untrusted data is validated. It is a functional risk, not a protection removed, and the early checks probably cover the common cases.

receipt_plan.detail: Rerun generator snapshot tests. Check that no snapshot using metadata generics (e.g. ValueTuple, KeyValuePair, custom generic collections) lost its generated formatter or resolver entry.
